questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Zimbabwe?

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Zimbabwe?

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Zimbabwe is home to the famous waterfall, _____ Falls, which is located on the Zambezi River and also the Great Zimbabwe, the ancient architectural monument from which the country was named after.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter V and has 8 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Zimbabwe article.

questions.proof: Zimbabwe is home to the famous waterfall, Victoria Falls, which is located on the Zambezi River and also the Great Zimbabwe, the ancient architectural monument from which the country was named after.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “The area that is now Zimbabwe was added to the British Empire around _____.”

questions.proof: The area that is now Zimbabwe was added to the British Empire around 1890.
